lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Raiders stole medical stock and machine parts. Recover the marked containers.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: The manifest begins after the alleged theft.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: Meaning there is no record of the state owning any of it.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Secure the containers intact. We inspect everything ourselves.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: Antibiotics, irrigation seals, infant formula. Every crate is addressed to Hollowmere.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: The state stamped “recovered property” over the original settlement marks.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Copy the manifests. Command gets nothing until I know who ordered this.

lines.speaker: broadcast
lines.text: Loyal forces have returned stolen aid to its rightful government custodians.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: The manifests are moving. We need another approach before command erases the site.

midBattle.speaker: vale
midBattle.text: Disable the defenses. Do not rupture the containers.

midBattle.speaker: reyes
midBattle.text: Medical hazard markings. These crates were packed for civilian clinics.

midBattle.speaker: kell
midBattle.text: Civilian vehicle in the depot. No raider escort, no weapons rack.

midBattle.speaker: reyes
midBattle.text: Manifest recovered. Hollowmere purchase order—dated before command claimed the theft.

midBattle.speaker: vale
midBattle.text: Both manifests secured. Preserve the raw files and move.
